2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest would use the full 16‑month OPRA cache (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) with no look‑ahead bias; risk of overfit due to multiple hyperparameter sweeps across the codebase.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk‑forward held‑out window not yet run).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top‑3 J days not yet validated against realistic OPRA simulator).  
5. **Failure modes:** worst day = a loser day where engine takes the trade and incurs >‑$300 loss; max drawdown scenario = consecutive loser days with unmanaged stops; blow‑up scenario = volatility spike causing premature premium stop hits on winner days.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top‑5‑day % of P&L.
